summary.zh: 先写必失败的测试，验证修复真的生效
summary.en: Prove a bug with a test that fails first, then passes

description.zh: 把怀疑中的缺陷变成有证据的结论：先确认成因，写一个在当前代码上必然失败的测试，修好后撤回修复，看它重新变红。适合修缺陷、处理线上事故或加固偶发失败的测试时使用。
description.en: Turns a suspected bug into proof: confirm the cause, write a test that fails on current code, apply the fix, then revert it and watch the test go red again. Use it when fixing bugs or chasing incidents.
